question: What is the WABT end-of-run trigger temperature for HCU-2?
actual_answer:
The WABT (Weighted Average Bed Temperature) end-of-run trigger temperature for HCU-2 is > 410 °C. [N] 

[N] Source: SOP-114-Rev3_Hydrocracker_Catalyst_Changeout.docx, Revision History section indicates this value was updated based on catalyst vendor guidance in Rev 2 (2023-11-18).

question: What caused the off-spec batch H110F-0847?
expected_answer: Catalyst feed rate excursion during grade changeover, ~40 min before DCS alarm response
actual_answer: According to the Novolen Batch QA Report from August 2026 [5], the root cause of the off-spec batch H110F-0847 was a catalyst feed rate excursion during the grade changeover process from Homopolymer H030SG [2].

question: What is the 8-hour TWA benzene exposure limit at the Aromatic Complex?
actual_answer: The 8-hour Time Weighted Average (TWA) benzene exposure limit at the Aromatic Complex for personnel working in or near the Benzene storage and loading area (TK-701 to TK-704) is 1 ppm [1].

question: Why was Tank TK-K-03 at Kasargod held out of service?
expected_answer: 0.6% calibration variance exceeding the 0.3% internal tolerance
actual_answer: Tank TK-K-03 at Kasargod was held out of service because the third-party calibration agency's dip-chart figures showed a variance of 0.6% against the previous calibration certificate, which is above the internal tolerance of 0.3% for MS tanks as per Depot Operations Manual Section 5.2 [1]. This discrepancy required re-calibration before the tank could be returned to receipt service [1].

question: What was the root cause of the Hassan pumping station incident on 2026-07-22?
expected_answer: Minor seal leak at pump P-HS-02 discharge flange
actual_answer: The root cause of the Hassan pumping station incident on 2026-07-22 was a minor seal leak at pump P-HS-02 discharge flange. [1]

question: Did any PSA unit fall below its purity target in the last reporting period?
expected_answer: Yes, PSA-3, in the final 3 weeks of the log
actual_answer:
Yes, PSA-3 fell below its purity target of 99.9% during the final weeks of the reporting period. Specifically:

- On 2026-08-09, PSA-3 Purity was 99.641%, which is below the target.
- This trend continued with further declines on subsequent dates: 
  - On 2026-08-16, PSA-3 Purity was 99.63%.
  - On 2026-08-23, PSA-3 Purity was 99.633%.

This downward drift in purity for PSA-3 was noted as a deliberate test case in the provided synthetic data [1][3].

question: Which Kero Merox sample exceeded the sulphur spec limit?
actual_answer: The Kero Merox sample that exceeded the sulphur spec limit was taken on 2026-08-19, with a Sulphur content of 11.2 ppm, which exceeds the Spec Limit of 10 ppm [1].

question: Which vendor supplies both the hydrocracker catalyst and the Ziegler-Natta catalyst component?
